name: LeetSwap WETH/FREN pair fee-transfer drain
summary: LeetSwapV2Pair exposed its fee-transfer helper publicly without caller, token, or amount authorization. An unprivileged caller could move a pair's counterpart-token balance into its fees contract, synchronize the depleted reserve, and drain WETH through the resulting reserve distortion.

loss.notes: The pair sent 15.696794587395952794 WETH to the attack helper across two pair-specific drain transactions. Excluding the helper's two identifiable 0.001 WETH setup-swap inputs leaves exact pre-recovery victim depletion of 15.694794587395952794 WETH, valued at DefiLlama's nearest observation of $1,863.01. The public fee-transfer calls also moved the counterpart token into the pair's fees contract; those internal transfers are excluded because claim allocation and recoverability cannot be isolated from the receipts, so no speculative counterpart-token value is assigned.

ageReset.description: LeetSwap factory CREATE2 deployment of this immutable-bearing pair runtime. Archival code is absent in block 2029742 and hashes to 0x11ccaa9724bb0039422598492778dfa22e04be499970a182596605712d6eded6 at deployment and immediately before the incident; the pair has no proxy code-selection path.

sources.note: Campaign boundary: calldata enumeration of the original EOA's successful transactions shows 0x0bbc4c363f31485bdaeeca37fa248f48f688f18ddbc59e3fa9f016a093df687c is the first of two defect-executing drain transactions against pair 0x83097b68027239c89576825bbb808ac405bf1c1e; other LeetSwap pair deployments are separate records with separate losses and ages. Verified LeetSwapV2Pair source exposes _transferFeesSupportingTaxTokens(address,uint256) as a public function with no caller, token, or amount authorization. The transaction trace calls it for the counterpart-token balance, calls sync(), and then swaps the setup tokens for WETH at the corrupted reserves. Code history: factory 0x169c06b4cfb09bfd73a81e6f2bb1eb514d75bb19 CREATE2-deployed the pair in 0x2649fbd622297b03cf4dc740a0bab073596ed8898b14a610083c42c4c86449d2 at block 2029743:3; archival code is empty in the preceding block and the immutable-bearing direct runtime hashes to 0x11ccaa9724bb0039422598492778dfa22e04be499970a182596605712d6eded6 at creation and before the anchor. Loss: receipt Transfer logs show exactly 15.696794587395952794 WETH leaving this pair for helper 0xea8f89f47f3d4293897b4fe8cb69b5c233b9f560 across 0x0bbc4c363f31485bdaeeca37fa248f48f688f18ddbc59e3fa9f016a093df687c and 0x226fa7176ae637dc4c8bcb9bc37f9b92a9c0b5f823c5a1446855fc3c70e08d1a. The counterpart-token transfer goes to the pair's own fees contract and is not valued because its claim allocation/recoverability is not isolated.

notes: This pair-specific record is part of a coordinated same-attacker LeetSwap umbrella. Loss is partitioned by pair deployment and is not duplicated across sibling records.
